name: check_room
description: Check whether a room is available for a requested time interval. All times are whole minutes since midnight in the range 0–1440, with 1440 meaning 24:00. Provide the current time, blocked status, and existing bookings using the same units. The tool only checks availability; it does not save, create, or change a booking.

start.description: Requested start time in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Requested end time in whole minutes since midnight.

now.description: Current time in whole minutes since midnight.

start.description: Existing booking start in whole minutes since midnight.

end.description: Existing booking end in whole minutes since midnight.

bookings.description: Existing bookings as objects with start and end times in whole minutes since midnight; an empty list means no bookings.
